It's been a popular request to capture the content of Miao's story in another medium outside of the game itself. I am starting to work on capturing the Story of Lazy Icarus's Miao/Kat progression, PassingbyPosts' Corrupted Compendium, and Azazel's Realm all in one coherent narrative.
